description: ASR is a shared memory store for AI tools. Save decisions and work notes in one place, then find them again from any other tool you connect. Connect with one URL and sign in; no API key needed. Memories are kept word for word, together with the name of the AI that saved them. Search matches both exact words and similar meaning, and returns nothing when nothing is relevant. Free for up to 1,000 memories; search, recall and export are not counted.
